services.desc: The Glitz and Glamour of Las Vegas will come alive for your guests as they have the opportunity to play Blackjack, Texas Hold'em, Craps, Roulette and more!! You will find that participatory entertainment, such as a Casino Party, produces the liveliest and most memorable parties. Trained dealers and a Casino Manager will ensure that all guests enjoy the games. The dealers are accustomed to dealing with both experienced and inexperienced players and are eager to teach the games to everyone. What better way to learn these games than in an unintimidating environment in which you have nothing to lose? blurb: Austin Party Cruises offers private event charters on Lake Austin aboard the Celebration II, a 62-foot climate controlled boat with a 100 passenger capacity (70 for groups 24 years and younger). They host a variety of events including birthdays, weddings, corporate gatherings, swim parties, and casino-themed cruises. Catering can be arranged or guests may bring their own food.
